import json, subprocess, sys

PROG = "/app/submission/scheduler.py"

def run_raw(data):
    if isinstance(data, str):
        data = data.encode()
    proc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "-B", PROG], input=data,
                          stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    return proc.returncode, proc.stdout, proc.stderr

def expect_invalid(name, data):
    rc, out, err = run_raw(data)
    ok = rc == 2 and out == b'{"error":"invalid input"}\n' and err == b""
    print(("PASS " if ok else "FAIL ") + name, "" if ok else (rc, out[:200], err[:300]))
    return ok

def expect_valid(name, obj):
    rc, out, err = run_raw(json.dumps(obj).encode())
    ok = rc == 0
    try:
        parsed = json.loads(out)
        ok = ok and isinstance(parsed, dict) and "error" not in parsed
    except Exception:
        ok = False
    print(("PASS " if ok else "FAIL ") + name, "" if ok else (rc, out[:200], err[:300]))
    return ok

B = {"mode": "burst", "banks": 2, "lanes": 1, "limit": 20, "borders": [0, 10, 20],

     "capacity": 1, "epoch": 2, "steps": [{"t": 0, "serve": True, "arrivals": []}]}
